items.pos: n. 預算 | v. 編列預算
items.colloc: annual budget 年度預算 | balance the budget 平衡預算
items.distinct: fund 資金 | capital 資本
ex: The company adjusted the annual budget.
公司調整了年度預算。
We need to budget for equipment.
我們需要為設備編列預算。
Their marketing budget was increased.
他們的行銷預算增加了。

items.colloc: reduce expenditure 減少支出 | capital expenditure 資本支出
items.distinct: expense 費用 | cost 成本
ex: Public expenditure rose significantly this year.
今年的公共支出顯著上升。
Strict control of expenditure is necessary.
嚴格控制支出是有必要的。
They analyzed the company's expenditure.
他們分析了公司的支出。

items.colloc: generate revenue 產生收入 | total revenue 總收入
items.distinct: profit 利潤 | income 所得
ex: The firm reported a record revenue.
該公司報告了創紀錄的營收。
Advertising provides most of our revenue.
廣告提供了我們大部分的營收。
The government aims to increase revenue.
政府目標是增加稅收。

items.colloc: pay a dividend 發放股利 | annual dividend 年度股利
items.distinct: bonus 獎金 | interest 利息
ex: Shareholders expect a higher dividend.
股東們期待更高的股利。
The board approved the dividend payment.
董事會核准了股利發放。
Earnings are distributed as dividends.
盈餘以股利形式分配。

items.colloc: declare bankruptcy 宣告破產 | face bankruptcy 面臨破產
items.distinct: insolvency 無力償還 | liquidation 清算
ex: The retailer filed for bankruptcy protection.
這家零售商申請了破產保護。
Poor management led to their bankruptcy.
管理不善導致了他們的倒閉。
Many small businesses face bankruptcy.
許多小型企業面臨破產。

items.colloc: assess profitability 評估獲利能力 | improve profitability 提升獲利能力
items.distinct: profit 利潤 | gain 收益
ex: The new strategy focuses on profitability.
新策略聚焦於獲利能力。
Low demand impacted the company's profitability.
需求疲軟影響了公司的獲利能力。
Investors monitor the quarterly profitability.
投資者監控每季的獲利能力。

items.colloc: fixed asset 固定資產 | liquid asset 流動資產
items.distinct: liability 負債 | property 財產
ex: The company has valuable overseas assets.
該公司擁有珍貴的海外資產。
Efficient staff are a company's asset.
高效的員工是公司的資產。
They sold off several non-core assets.
他們變賣了幾個非核心資產。

items.colloc: current liability 流動負債 | limit one's liability 限制責任
items.distinct: debt 債務 | asset 資產
ex: The firm has substantial long-term liabilities.
該公司有大量的長期負債。
The contract clarifies the total liability.
合約釐清了總負債額度。
His experience is a great liability here.
他的經驗在此處反而是負擔。

items.colloc: fiscal year 會計年度 | fiscal policy 財政政策
items.distinct: financial 金融的 | monetary 貨幣的
ex: The new fiscal year starts in April.
新會計年度從四月開始。
They presented the fiscal report today.
他們今天提出了財政報告。
Government adjustments affected fiscal stability.
政府的調整影響了財政穩定。

items.colloc: deduct tax 扣稅 | deduct from the total 從總額扣除
items.distinct: subtract 減去 | reduce 減少
ex: The company will deduct the expenses.
公司將會扣除相關費用。
We deduct taxes from your salary.
我們從你的薪水中扣除稅款。
Can you deduct the service charge?
你可以扣除服務費嗎？

items.colloc: bank transaction 銀行交易 | process a transaction 處理交易
items.distinct: deal 協議 | operation 營運
ex: Every transaction is recorded electronically.
每筆交易都有電子記錄。
Please confirm your recent bank transaction.
請確認您最近的銀行交易。
Online transactions are very secure now.
線上交易現在非常安全。

items.pos: n. 基準 | v. 設定基準
items.colloc: set a benchmark 設定基準 | performance benchmark 績效基準
items.distinct: standard 標準 | criterion 準則
ex: The results serve as a benchmark.
這些結果適合作為基準。
We benchmark our prices against competitors.
我們以競爭對手為基準來訂價。
The company exceeded the industry benchmark.
該公司超過了產業平均水準。

items.colloc: maintain liquidity 維持流動性 | market liquidity 市場流動性
items.distinct: cash 現金 | capital 資本
ex: The firm has excellent market liquidity.
該公司具備極佳的市場流動性。
They struggle with short-term liquidity.
他們在短期資金流動性上有困難。
Strong liquidity allows for faster growth.
良好的流動性有助於快速成長。

items.pos: n. 審計 | v. 稽核
items.colloc: external audit 外部審計 | internal audit 內部稽核
items.distinct: inspection 檢查 | review 審查
ex: The firm undergoes an annual audit.
公司每年都會進行審計。
The accountant will audit the records.
會計師將會稽核這些記錄。
We passed the recent tax audit.
我們通過了最近的稅務審計。

items.pos: n. 預測 | v. 預報
items.colloc: sales forecast 銷售預測 | economic forecast 經濟預測
items.distinct: prediction 預言 | projection 規劃
ex: The sales forecast looks quite optimistic.
銷售預測看起來相當樂觀。
Analysts forecast a steady growth rate.
分析師預測會有穩定成長率。
They revised the revenue forecast today.
他們今天修改了營收預測。

items.colloc: working capital 營運資金 | raise capital 募集資金
items.distinct: asset 資產 | wealth 財富
ex: The startup needs more initial capital.
這家新創公司需要更多初始資本。
They are seeking to raise capital.
他們正尋求募集資金。
He invested all his capital here.
他把所有資本都投資在這裡。

items.colloc: budget deficit 預算赤字 | trade deficit 貿易赤字
items.distinct: loss 損失 | shortage 短缺
ex: The company aims to reduce the deficit.
公司目標是減少赤字。
They face a significant budget deficit.
他們面臨巨大的預算赤字。
Export growth will help the deficit.
出口成長將有助於改善赤字。

items.colloc: market valuation 市場估值 | property valuation 資產估價
items.distinct: estimate 估計 | price 價格
ex: The company has a high market valuation.
該公司擁有很高的市場估值。
They conducted a thorough property valuation.
他們進行了徹底的資產估價。
Investors questioned the firm's valuation.
投資者質疑該公司的估值。
